 Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 now available in PH for ₱9,995
 By Bryan Rilloraza 
 October 27, 2026 
 The Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 is now available in the Philippines . The new open-ear earbuds focus on comfort, clear calls, and keeping you aware of your surroundings throughout the day.
 Unlike traditional earbuds, the AeroClip 2 clips to the outer ear instead of sitting inside the ear canal. Anker says the design was developed using data from more than 2,000 ear profiles and tested by over 1,000 users. Each earbud weighs just 6.2 grams, making it light enough for long listening sessions.
 For audio, the earbuds come with 12mm dual-magnetic drivers, LDAC support for Android devices, Hi-Res Audio certification, and HearID 5.0 sound personalization. The open-ear design also lets you hear what’s happening around you, which can be useful during commutes, outdoor walks, and workouts.
 Anker is also putting the spotlight on call quality. The AeroClip 2 uses a THUS AI Chip and 6-Sensor Call Technology to reduce background noise and focus on your voice during calls. This technology earned the earbuds a Guinness World Records certification for call clarity in the open-ear clip-on category.
 The earbuds pack an IP57 rating for dust and water resistance, making them suitable for exercise and outdoor use. They also feature a built-in Nap Mode that plays downloadable white noise tracks through the Anker app.
 Battery life is rated at up to 8 hours on a single charge and up to 32 hours with the charging case. A quick 10-minute charge can provide up to 4 hours of listening time.

 The Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 comes in Burgundy Red, Midnight Black, Cloud White, and Mist Blue. It is now available for ₱9,995 through Anker’s official Shopee , Lazada , and TikTok Shop stores, as well as authorized retailers nationwide.
